thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Error rate spike detected for /v1/generate in us-east-1 (5xx > 8% over 2m). Auto-throttle engaged. Incident ID: INC-2140000000

alex (oncall): Ack. I'm jumping in. Can someone grab the logs and recent deploys?

maria (sre): Looking at the last 10m. Increase in downstream timeouts to a third-party embedding cache, stack traces show `IOTimeoutError` from embedding-service-client. No deploys in past hour.

emily (eng-prod): We're seeing elevated tail latency on GPU pool gpu-pool-3 too. Could be cascading backpressure from failed KV cache calls. P95 generation latency up from 120ms -> 900ms.

alex (oncall): OK. Prioritize restoring cache paths. sam (support) can you hold customer-facing messages until we know scope?

sam (support): Yep. I'll stand by. Have a templated note ready for affected customers.

maria (sre): Quick mitigations: 1) route traffic away from gpu-pool-3 via routing rule `avoid-gpu3` (2) increase cache client retries with short backoff (3) enable fallback to model-variant `gen-v1-quant` for slow requests. Applying 1 now.

incident-bot: Deploy job 98765 started: apply routing rule avoid-gpu3 -> expected 30s

statuspage-bot: Draft statuspage entry prepared (private): "Investigating: Elevated errors for /v1/generate in us-east-1; mitigation in progress."

alex (oncall): Routing change applied, traffic rebalanced. Monitoring.

maria (sre): After routing change, errors dropped to ~3% and latency moved to ~300ms. Still higher than baseline. Working on fallback config rollout.

emily (eng-prod): Rolling out fallback model variant now (canary at 10%).

incident-bot: Canary rollout success 10% -> 50% -> 100% completed. Fallback engaged.

alex (oncall): Good. Looks like service is stable. Need to estimate customer impact window for SLA review. When did the spike start?

maria (sre): Metrics show onset at 2140000012 (approx) and error rate normalized at 2140001800 when routing + fallback fully in place. Total ~29 minutes of elevated errors, with highest impact first 9 minutes (errors > 6%).

jenna (cs): From support queue, we have 14 customers with active alerts or increased error reports in the last 30m. Affected plans: mix of Pay-as-you-go and Dedicated. Major customers flagged: finance-app-co, chatflow, docsgen-inc.

sam (support): I'll start drafting outbound for customers who reported errors. For broader customer notification, do we want a statuspage public update?

alex (oncall): Yes — publish a brief public post that we're investigating and will follow up with root cause + any restitution if eligible. Draft in thread before publishing.

statuspage-bot: Proposed public update:
```
Investigating: We are seeing an elevated error rate for the text generation API in US-East. Mitigations are in progress; customers may experience failed requests or higher latency. We will provide updates shortly.
```

alex (oncall): Edit: add timeframe estimate and incident id.

statuspage-bot: Edited public update:
```
Investigating (INC-2140000000, started ~2140000012 UTC): Elevated error rate for the text generation API in US‑East. Mitigations applied; some customers may have seen failed requests or increased latency between ~2140000012 and ~2140001800 UTC. We will post a postmortem and any customer restitution details after RCA.
```

jenna (cs): Draft customer email for directly affected customers (short):
```
Hi {name},
We detected an incident affecting text generation in US‑East (INC-2140000000) between ~2140000012 and ~2140001800 UTC. During this time you may have experienced failed requests or increased latency. Our engineering team applied mitigations and service has returned to normal. We will follow up with a detailed root cause and any eligibility for account credit as applicable. Apologies for the disruption.
— Redwood Inference support
```

alex (oncall): Good. Now SLA credit eligibility check: how many customers exceeded SLA? We need per-customer window of failed requests and request counts.

troy (billing): I'll need a list of affected customer IDs + token usage during window. Can SRE export usage by tenant for 2140000012–2140001800? Also flag Dedicated contracts with custom SLAs.

maria (sre): Running query: `SELECT tenant_id, count(*) as failed, total_requests FROM request_logs WHERE path='/v1/generate' AND timestamp BETWEEN 2140000012 AND 2140001800 GROUP BY tenant_id;` Will paste CSV shortly.

(maria uploads CSV snippet)
```
tenant_id,failed,total_requests
cust-104,25,1200
cust-207,3,5
cust-333,0,450
finance-app-co,18,80
chatflow,6,150
```

jenna (cs): finance-app-co and chatflow reported support tickets. Finance-app-co had several timeouts in production flows.

alex (oncall): For SLA, our policy: if rolling 1-hour error rate for a tenant exceeds 5% and impacts production traffic, customer may be eligible for a prorated credit per SLA terms. Need legal/billing ok before promising credits.

troy (billing): Got it. From CSV: finance-app-co failed/total = 22.5% -> likely eligible. cust-104 ~2% -> below threshold. chatflow 4% -> below but borderline. We'll mark finance-app-co for credit assessment. I need plan type and contract start.

sam (support): I'll prepare the initial customer notice for finance-app-co offering acknowledgement and next steps. Draft: 
```
Hi Finance App team,
We detected an incident (INC-2140000000) that affected your requests to /v1/generate between ~2140000012 and ~2140001800 UTC. Our records show approximately 18 failed requests out of 80 in that window. We're investigating root cause and will determine credit eligibility under your SLA. Please let us know if you'd like a dedicated post-incident call.
Thanks, Sam
```

alex (oncall): Good. Troy — once you confirm the contract and calculate the credit amount, post the numbers in this thread. Keep it conservative.

troy (billing): Contract check: finance-app-co is on Annual Dedicated (SLA 99.9 uptime, monthly invoice). For 29min impact, equivalent downtime fraction = 29 / (30*24*60) ~ 0.067% of monthly minutes. SLA credit formula: if availability < SLA, credit = min(100%, (SLA - availability)/SLA * monthly_fee). Will compute precise prorated credit once I have exact invoice period minutes + monthly fee. Please create ticket for finance with credit estimate + approval flow.

maria (sre): Captured logs and traces for RCA: root cause appears to be intermittent TCP resets from embedding-cache cluster due to a bug in connection pool when inflight retries spike. We'll produce a changelog and patch for connection pool to roll in tomorrow. Postmortem will include timeline and mitigations.

alex (oncall): Action items:
- maria: full RCA + remediation PR (#1452) by EOD.
- troy: calculate credit estimate and open billing ticket by EOD.
- jenna/sam: send acknowledgement to finance-app-co and chatflow (sam will send).
- emily: coordinate permanent routing rules to avoid single GPU pool hot spots.

sam (support): Sent acknowledgement to finance-app-co and chatflow, copied legal and billing. Customers asked for ETA on postmortem; I gave EOD for initial RCA and 3 business days for full postmortem.

jenna (cs): Noting customer sentiment: finance-app-co very concerned; offered 1:1 call. They asked specifically about data loss (none reported) and retry semantics.

emily (eng-prod): Temporary patch to connection pool merged to main, staged to canary. Will schedule a full revert/patch tomorrow with QA.

incident-bot: Incident resolved. Final status: mitigations applied; service healthy. Please file postmortem and follow SLA credit runbook.

alex (oncall): Closing notes for handoff to incident review: attach timeline, CSV of tenant impact, statuspage update, customer messages, credit candidate list (finance-app-co). I'll file the review ticket. Good job team.

statuspage-bot: Public update posted: "Resolved: Mitigations applied; service normal. Postmortem and credit eligibility details will follow (INC-2140000000)."

jenna (cs): I'll follow up with finance-app-co to schedule the call.

end of thread
